mapper.select: SELECT fair_id FROM fairs WHERE status = 'PAYMENT_PENDING' AND payment_due_at IS NOT NULL AND payment_due_at <= #{now} ORDER BY payment_due_at, fair_id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED

SELECT fair_id FROM fairs WHERE status = 'PREPARING' AND operation_start_date IS NOT NULL AND operation_start_date <= #{today} ORDER BY operation_start_date, fair_id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
SELECT fair_id FROM fairs WHERE status = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND operation_end_date IS NOT NULL AND operation_end_date < #{today} ORDER BY operation_end_date, fair_id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
